papers.title: EVA: Evolving Semantic Adversaries for Red-Teaming GUI Agents Against Environmental Injection Attacks
papers.authors: Yijie Lu, Manman Zhao, Tianjie Ju, Zihe Yan, Xinbei Ma, Yuan Guo, Daizong Ding, Gongshen Liu, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Yijie Lu - School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University; Manman Zhao - School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University; Tianjie Ju - School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Zihe Yan - School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Xinbei Ma - School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Yuan Guo - School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Daizong Ding - Independent Researcher; Gongshen Liu - School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Zhuosheng Zhang - School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文提出EVA框架，通过将攻击聚焦于语义欺骗维度，利用离线进化挖掘漏洞模式并蒸馏为可泛化规则，实现在线零样本黑盒注入攻击，揭示语义欺骗是攻击成功的主要瓶颈并发现对齐悖论。

papers.title: Scaling Computer-Use Grounding via User Interface Decomposition and Synthesis
papers.authors: Tianbao Xie, Jiaqi Deng, Xiaochuan Li, Junlin Yang, Haoyuan Wu, Jixuan Chen, Wenjing Hu, Xinyuan Wang, Yuhui Xu, Zekun Wang, Yiheng Xu, Junli Wang, Doyen Sahoo, Tao Yu, Caiming Xiong
papers.tags: visual grounding, multimodal learning, scene understanding, gui
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, Salesforce AI Research
papers.intro: 本文通过分解用户界面和任务，构建了大规模的GUI定位数据集JEDI（4百万样本）和基准OSWorld-G（564个精细标注样本），训练出的多尺度模型在多个定位基准上达到最优，并显著提升了通用基础模型在复杂计算机任务上的代理能力（OSWorld上从23%提升至51%）。

papers.title: Scalable Video-to-Dataset Generation for Cross-Platform Mobile Agents

papers.affiliations: University of Michigan, LG AI Research

papers.title: Learning Informative Attention Weights for Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Yancheng Wang, Nebojsa Jojic, Yingzhen Yang
papers.affiliations: Yancheng Wang, Yingzhen Yang - School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence, Arizona State University; Nebojsa Jojic - Microsoft Research
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于信息瓶颈（IB）原理的Reduction of Information Bottleneck loss（RIB）框架，通过最小化一个无分布假设且可高效优化的变分上界IBB，联合DCS-Attention和现有通道注意力模块，学习更具信息量的注意力权重，从而显著提升Person Re-…

papers.title: EnronQA: Towards Personalized RAG over Private Documents
papers.authors: Michael J. Ryan, Danmei Xu, Chris Nivera, Daniel Campos
papers.affiliations: Stanford University（Michael J. Ryan，工作完成于Snowflake实习）；Snowflake（Danmei Xu, Chris Nivera, Daniel Campos）
papers.intro: 本文发布了一个基于Enron邮件语料的大规模私有文档问答基准EnronQA（103,638封邮件、528,304个问答对、150个用户收件箱），并基于该基准评测了RAG管道在私有文档上的性能，展示出检索相对于无检索和参数记忆的显著优势。

papers.title: LLM-Powered GUI Agents in Phone Automation: Surveying Progress and Prospects
papers.authors: Guangyi Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Yaozhen Liang, Liang Liu, Yaxuan Guo, Han Xiao, Weifeng Lin, Yuxiang Chai, Yue Han, Shuai Ren, Hao Wang, Xiaoyu Liang, WenHao Wang, Tianze Wu, Zhengxi Lu, Siheng Chen, LiLinghao, Hao Wang, Guanjing Xiong, Yong Liu, Hongsheng Li
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, vivo AI Lab, CUHK MMLab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文系统地综述了LLM驱动的手机GUI代理，从传统脚本自动化到智能自适应系统的演变，提出包含框架、建模方法、数据集与基准的完整分类体系，并深入分析了LLM如何赋能手机自动化，最后指出开放挑战与未来方向。

papers.title: LearnAct: Few-Shot Mobile GUI Agent with a Unified Demonstration Benchmark
papers.authors: Guangyi Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Liang Liu, Zhiming Chen, Yuxiang Chai, Shuai Ren, Hao Wang, Shibo He, Wenchao Meng
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Guangyi Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Shibo He, Wenchao Meng）；vivo AI Lab（Liang Liu, Zhiming Chen, Yuxiang Chai, Shuai Ren, Hao Wang）
papers.intro: 本文提出LearnGUI（首个专用于演示学习的移动GUI基准数据集）和LearnAct（一个多智能体框架），通过从少量人类演示中自动提取、检索和利用知识，显著提升移动GUI代理在未见场景中的任务完成能力，在离线评估中将Gemini-1.5-Pro的准确率从19.3%提升至51.7%，在线评估中将UI…

papers.title: TongUI: Internet-Scale Trajectories from Multimodal Web Tutorials for Generalized GUI Agents
papers.authors: Bofei Zhang, Zirui Shang, Zhi Gao, Wang Zhang, Rui Xie, Xiaojian Ma, Tao Yuan, Xinxiao Wu, Song-Chun Zhu, Qing Li
papers.affiliations: Bofei Zhang - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI；Zirui Shang - Beijing Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Technology, School of Computer Science & Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, 以及 State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI；Zhi Gao - Beijing Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Technology, School of Computer Science & Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, 以及 State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI, 以及 School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Peking University；Wang Zhang - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI；Rui Xie - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI, 以及 Shanghai Jiao Tong University；Xiaojian Ma - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI；Tao Yuan - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI；Xinxiao Wu - Beijing Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Technology, School of Computer Science & Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology；Song-Chun Zhu - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI, 以及 School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Peking University, 以及 Department of Automation, Tsinghua University；Qing Li - State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI
papers.intro: 本文提出TongUI框架，通过爬取并处理互联网上丰富的多模态教程（视频和图文文章），自动化地将其转化为大规模、跨平台的GUI轨迹数据（GUI-Net-1M数据集，含100万条轨迹），并基于此微调Qwen2.5-VL模型，在多个GUI接地与导航基准上取得约10%的显著提升。

papers.title: ScreenSpot-Pro: GUI Grounding for Professional High-Resolution Computer Use
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.affiliations: Kaixin Li - National University of Singapore; Ziyang Meng - East China Normal University; Hongzhan Lin - Hong Kong Baptist University; Ziyang Luo - Salesforce Research; Yuchen Tian - Hong Kong Baptist University; Jing Ma - Hong Kong Baptist University; Zhiyong Huang - National University of Singapore; Tat-Seng Chua - National University of Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出ScreenSpot-Pro基准和ScreenSeekeR方法，通过利用MLLM规划器引导的分级搜索策略，在不进行额外训练的情况下显著提升了高分辨率专业软件场景下的GUI grounding精度（相对提升254%）。

papers.title: UI-Vision: A Desktop-centric GUI Benchmark for Visual Perception and Interaction
papers.authors: Shravan Nayak, Xiangru Jian, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Juan A. Rodriguez, Montek Kalsi, Rabiul Awal, Nicolas Chapados, M. Tamer Özsu, Aishwarya Agrawal, David Vazquez, Christopher Pal, Perouz Taslakian, Spandana Gella, Sai Rajeswar
papers.affiliations: Mila - Quebec AI Institute, Université de Montréal, ServiceNow, University of Waterloo, National University of Singapore, École de Technologie Supérieure, CIFAR AI Chair, Polytechnique Montréal
papers.intro: UI-Vision是一个覆盖83个桌面应用、提供密集人工标注（边界框、标签、动作轨迹）并设计元素定位、布局定位和动作预测三项任务的离线基准，揭示了当前SOTA模型在桌面GUI感知与交互上的显著不足。

papers.title: Think Twice, Click Once: Enhancing GUI Grounding via Fast and Slow Systems
papers.authors: Fei Tang, Yongliang Shen, Hang Zhang, Siqi Chen, Guiyang Hou, Wenqi Zhang, Wenqiao Zhang, Kaitao Song, Weiming Lu, Yueting Zhuang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University; Microsoft Research Asia
papers.intro: 提出FOCUS框架，通过模仿人类双系统认知（快速直觉判断与慢速分析推理），结合自适应系统切换机制，实现了在GUI grounding任务中兼顾效率与准确性，并在ScreenSpot和ScreenSpot-Pro上达到最优性能。

papers.title: FedMABench: Benchmarking Mobile Agents on Decentralized Heterogeneous User Data
papers.authors: Wenhao Wang, Zijie Yu, Rui Ye, Jianqing Zhang, Siheng Chen, Yanfeng Wang
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学，上海人工智能实验室（Wenhao Wang）；上海交通大学（Zijie Yu, Rui Ye, Jianqing Zhang, Siheng Chen）；上海人工智能实验室（Siheng Chen, Yanfeng Wang）
papers.intro: 提出FedMABench，首个针对联邦学习训练与评估移动代理的综合性基准，包含6个数据集（30+子集）、8种联邦算法和10+基础模型，专注于异构场景下的移动代理性能研究。

papers.title: Evaluating the Robustness of Multimodal Agents Against Active Environmental Injection Attacks
papers.authors: Yurun Chen, Xavier Hu, Keting Yin, Juncheng Li, Shengyu Zhang
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学
papers.intro: 本文首次提出主动环境注入攻击（AEIA）的概念，并设计了基于移动通知的攻击方案AEIA-MN，通过三种攻击策略（对抗性攻击、推理间隙攻击及组合攻击）在AndroidWorld和AppAgent基准测试中实现了高达93%的攻击成功率，揭示了当前MLLM代理对这类攻击的脆弱性。

papers.title: YOLOv12: Attention-Centric Real-Time Object Detectors
papers.authors: Yunjie Tian, Qixiang Ye, David Doermann
papers.affiliations: University at Buffalo, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, University at Buffalo
papers.intro: 本文提出YOLOv12，一个以注意力为中心的实时目标检测框架，通过面积注意力、残差高效层聚合网络和多项架构改进，在匹配CNN推理速度的同时显著超越所有现有实时检测器的精度。

papers.title: WorldGUI: An Interactive Benchmark for Desktop GUI Automation from Any Starting Point
papers.authors: Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Kaiming Yang, Wendi Yu, Difei Gao, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.affiliations: Show Lab, National University of Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出WorldGUI，一个覆盖10款应用、611个任务、带多样性初始状态的桌面GUI自动化基准，并引入基于三阶段批判的WorldGUI-Agent框架，揭示当前智能体在非默认初始条件下的脆弱规划行为。

papers.title: Advancing Autonomous VLM Agents via Variational Subgoal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Qingyuan Wu, Jianheng Liu, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: Qingyuan Wu - University of Liverpool, University of Southampton; Jianheng Liu - Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab; Jianye Hao - Tianjin University; Jun Wang - University College London; Kun Shao - Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab
papers.intro: 本文提出VSC-RL框架，将决策问题重构为变分子目标条件强化学习问题，通过VLM自动分解目标为子目标并优化新推导的SGC-ELBO目标，显著提升VLM智能体在稀疏奖励长周期任务中的学习效率和最终性能。

papers.title: AppVLM: A Lightweight Vision Language Model for Online App Control
papers.authors: Georgios Papoudakis, Thomas Coste, Zhihao Wu, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab（Georgios Papoudakis, Thomas Coste, Zhihao Wu, Jianye Hao, Kun Shao），University College London（Jun Wang）
papers.intro: AppVLM 提出了一种轻量级（3B参数）视觉语言模型，通过先在离线数据集AndroidControl上进行监督微调（SFT），再在AndroidWorld环境中进行迭代式的强化微调（RFT）来优化策略，从而在离线评估中达到最高动作预测精度，并在在线任务中取得与GPT-4o相当的成功率，同时推理速度…

papers.title: Multi-Branch Collaborative Learning Network for Video Quality Assessment in Industrial Video Search
papers.authors: Hengzhu Tang, Zefeng Zhang, Zhiping Li, Zhenyu Zhang, Xing Wu, Li Gao, Suqi Cheng, Dawei Yin
papers.affiliations: Baidu Inc.（百度公司）
papers.intro: 论文提出了一种面向工业视频检索的多分支协作学习网络MBCN，通过四个专门设计的质量评估分支分别建模视觉低层、文本、帧连贯性和帧文匹配四类质量问题，并使用挤压-激励机制动态融合分数，显著提升低质量视频识别准确率和检索排序性能。

papers.title: MobileA3gent: Training Mobile GUI Agents Using Decentralized Self-Sourced Data from Diverse Users
papers.authors: Wenhao Wang, Mengying Yuan, Zijie Yu, Guangyi Liu, Rui Ye, Tian Jin, Siheng Chen, Yanfeng Wang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Multi-Agent Governance & Intelligence Crew (MAGIC)
papers.intro: 本文提出MobileA3gent，一个通过自动标注用户日常操作轨迹（Auto-Annotation）并结合自适应联邦聚合（FedVLM-A）的协作学习框架，以极低成本训练出性能媲美中心化人工标注方法的移动GUI代理，同时保护用户隐私。

papers.title: GUI-Bee: Align GUI Action Grounding to Novel Environments via Autonomous Exploration
papers.authors: Yue Fan, Handong Zhao, Ruiyi Zhang, Yu Shen, Xin Eric Wang, Gang Wu
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz; Adobe Research
papers.intro: 本文提出GUI-Bee，一个基于MLLM的自主探索代理，通过强化学习驱动的高效探索收集环境专属数据，持续微调GUI动作定位模型，以使其适应新环境，并引入NovelScreenSpot基准验证效果。
